name: Dorothy Smith
source:
"Oh my oh my oh my! Is everything alright, Manson?"

A mysterious but rather pleasant woman who is Manson's roommate (Even though there's only one bed). She is so friendly, sweet, and kind it's impossible to get mad around her. No matter what happens, Dorothy will always be there for Manson.

[From [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/object-ward]Itch.io[/url]]

[Spoiler]Dorothy was constructed by Manson's subconscious to be his companion. While she was somewhat aware, she omitted this information for his mental health, leading to further disastrous results. In the Friendship ending, she disappears willingly, as there's no need for her anymore.[/spoiler]
